title: Activation Variance
prompt:
Compute the biased (1/n) variance σ² of the activations

    x = [6, 1, -1]

(σ² = (1/n)·Σ (xᵢ − μ)²)
hint: σ² = (Σ xᵢ²)/n − μ²; an exact fraction or a decimal is accepted
recap: The biased variance σ^2 = (Σ xᵢ^2)/n − μ^2 is the mean squared deviation from the mean. LayerNorm divides by √(σ^2 + ε) to unit-scale.
